title: Bayesian decisions and hidden dynamics
summary: Neuromatch W3D2 and W3D3: Bayesian inference with binary and continuous hidden states, loss functions and optimal decisions, fitting Bayesian observer models to behaviour; then inference about states that change in time, the sequential probability ratio test, hidden Markov models and the Kalman filter.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is Neuromatch W3D2 (Tutorials 1–2 and the bonus fitting tutorial) and W3D3 (Tutorials 1–3 and bonus Tutorials 4–5).

preparation.description: W3D2 Bayesian Decisions chapter page: Tutorial 1 Bayes with a binary hidden state, Tutorial 2 Bayesian inference and decisions with continuous hidden state, bonus Tutorial 3 Fitting to data.
W3D3 Hidden Dynamics chapter page: Tutorial 1 Sequential Probability Ratio Test, Tutorial 2 Hidden Markov Model, Tutorial 3 The Kalman Filter, bonus Tutorials 4–5.
